Content-Transfer-Encoding: binary Content-Location: https://sflix.win/assets/css/sflix-mobile-polish-v3.css?v=3 @charset "utf-8"; #header_login.user_logged { float: right; } #header_login.user_logged .header-user-button { height: 34px; max-width: 190px; padding: 0px 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; } #header_login.user_logged .header-user-icon { display: none; flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 17px; } #header_login.user_logged .header-user-name { min-width: 0px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } #header_login.user_logged .header-user-chevron { flex: 0 0 auto; font-size: 10px; } #header_login.user_logged .dropdown-menu-model { min-width: 250px; max-width: min(330px, -24px + 100vw); margin-top: 7px; } #header_login.user_logged .profile-info { min-width: 0px; } #header_login.user_logged .pi-name, #header_login.user_logged .pi-mail { max-width: 190px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } @media screen and (max-width: 1299px) { #header .container { min-height: 60px; } #header_right { z-index: 7; display: flex; align-items: center; position: absolute !important; top: 0px !important; right: 10px !important; bottom: auto !important; height: 60px !important; } #header_login.user_logged { display: flex; align-items: center; width: auto !important; height: 60px !important; margin: 0px !important; padding: 0px !important; } #header_login.user_logged .dropdown { position: relative; } #header_login.user_logged .header-user-button { height: 36px; max-width: 150px; padding: 0px 11px; } #header_login.user_logged .dropdown-menu-model { right: 0px !important; left: auto !important; transform: none !important; } } @media screen and (max-width: 639px) { #header .container { padding-left: 12px !important; padding-right: 12px !important; } #header_browser { margin-left: 0px; } #header #logo { left: 60px !important; } #mobile_search { right: 58px !important; width: 44px !important; } #header_right { right: 8px !important; width: 44px; } #header_login.user_logged, #header_login.user_logged .dropdown { width: 44px !important; } #header_login.user_logged .header-user-button { width: 44px; min-width: 44px; max-width: 44px; height: 40px; justify-content: center; padding: 0px !important; border-radius: 12px !important; background: rgba(0, 172, 193, 0.14) !important; border: 1px solid rgba(100, 217, 231, 0.22) !important; color: rgb(143, 232, 242) !important; box-shadow: none !important; } #header_login.user_logged .header-user-icon { display: inline-block; font-size: 19px; margin: 0px !important; } #header_login.user_logged .header-user-name, #header_login.user_logged .header-user-chevron { display: none; } #header_login.user_logged .dropdown-menu-model { width: min(290px, -24px + 100vw); min-width: 0px; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; position: absolute !important; top: calc(100% + 6px) !important; right: 0px !important; left: auto !important; margin: 0px !important; transform: none !important; } #header_login.user_logged .pi-name, #header_login.user_logged .pi-mail { max-width: 185px; } .detail_page-watch > .detail-tools { box-sizing: border-box; width: calc(100% - 24px) !important; margin: 14px 12px 12px !important; padding: 8px !important; position: relative !important; inset: auto !important; transform: none !important; z-index: 5 !important; border-radius: 14px !important; } .detail_page-watch > .detail-tools .dt-content { padding: 0px 1px 2px; scroll-padding-inline: 4px; gap: 6px !important; } .detail_page-watch > .detail-tools .dt-content > div, .detail_page-watch > .detail-tools #wl-content, .detail_page-watch > .detail-tools
